comments.author: Renee Castillo
comments.body: Hello, I’m reviewing our upcoming supply budget and wanted to ask whether Anchor Bay Surgical Partners can receive a small-volume discount on Tidewater T2 consumables, as we’re under budget pressure. I’m the practice administrator, and I’m contacting you today, August 26, 2026, to discuss this.

comments.author: Halvard Support
comments.body: Thanks, Renee. We’ll review the request and follow up with available pricing options.
